name: Updates
author: VanillaGreen
description: Checks system, VGS, plugin, theme and mise updates from one service, shows them in a bar widget and its flyout, and runs every update in one floating TUI.

requirements.purpose: Counts Arch repository updates without root
Takes a snapshot before the update TUI changes system packages
Takes a snapshot before the update TUI changes system packages when snapper is absent
Shows the last update log from the flyout

hideWhenCurrent.label: Hide when current
hideWhenCurrent.description: Hide the bar icon while the last check succeeded and no source has updates; a failed, stale or running check still shows

aurCommand.label: AUR command
aurCommand.description: Which AUR update command the update TUI runs

snapshot.label: Snapshot
snapshot.description: Automatic snapshots when the update TUI can find a snapshot tool

trustPluginUpdates.label: Trust plugin updates
trustPluginUpdates.description: Let the update TUI pass --yes to plugin and theme updates, so it shows their diffs without asking

placement.label: Flyout placement
placement.description: Where the updates flyout opens when summoned without its bar icon
